acceptanceCriteria: Ordinary start and work-item new fail closed on the repository primary worktree and default branch, while a dedicated linked worktree is accepted.
The guard has focused regression tests covering primary root, default branch, dedicated worktree, and missing/ambiguous remote metadata without false green.
Tri-language workflow documentation states the dedicated worktree requirement and predecessor WI-363 recovery boundary.
Published v0.2.37 artifacts are downloaded and checksum-bound with no source or workspace fallback.
Adopter and N-1 acceptance receipts prove runtime/repository identity, isolation, and temporary-root cleanup.
PR review/CI, archive, finalization, close, and exact branch/worktree cleanup leave synchronized main ready_on_base.
goal: Prevent ordinary Work Items from binding the repository primary worktree or default branch, then publish and verify v0.2.37 with complete finalization and close evidence.
intent: Root-fix the release delivery boundary exposed by WI-363 and redeliver the immutable v0.2.37 release from a dedicated Work Item worktree.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: primary worktree and default branch entry rejection
scenarioCoverage.expected: An ordinary Work Item cannot bind the repository primary worktree or default branch; the Runtime returns a stable fail-closed reason before writing a Contract.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run focused CLI regressions against a primary-root/default-branch repository and assert no Work Item files are created; run the same flow from a dedicated linked worktree and assert it remains eligible.

scenarioCoverage.reason: The public v0.2.37 artifact, adopter and N-1 receipts, hosted merge, and final cleanup are post-archive external boundaries; they cannot be verified before this Work Item is archived and its reviewed PR is merged.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The v0.2.37 release lifecycle runs on the dedicated Work Item worktree and finalization proves exact branch and worktree cleanup before close.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: After reviewed merge, run the immutable public artifact, adopter, N-1, finalization, close, and ready_on_base acceptance checks.
